provenance: Measured on 2026-10-23 using fresh PostgreSQL 17, all authoritative migrations, deterministic synthetic lifecycle sequences and existing cancellation/dispatch races
coverage_scope: selected production function statement coverage, not branch coverage or whole-repository coverage

functions.invariant: terminal cancellation is idempotent and task, current attempt, event and cancellation outbox commit together
new retry creates a unique monotonically increasing attempt, replay does not duplicate and foreign owner cannot mutate
delayed dispatch and exhausted lost acknowledgements cannot overwrite a committed newer lifecycle
